//: External linters used by `corepack yarn check:workflows` (M1-AC8, docs/test-plans/M1-S3.md; M1-AC33, docs/test-plans/M1-S8.md). One pinned version for the Pi and CI. Each `sha256` is the release tarball's, checked on 2026-10-04 and again on 2026-10-15 against the GitHub release asset digest and, for actionlint, its own actionlint_<version>_checksums.txt. `member` is the binary's path inside the tarball. `binarySha256` is the sha256 of that extracted binary, computed on 2026-10-15 from the verified tarballs (upstream publishes no per-binary checksum); it is checked on every run, for a cached binary as for a fresh download, before the binary is ever executed. The binaries are cached outside the repo under ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/notestead/tools/<name>-<version>/.
